note: Four resonance contributors of the benzenediazonium (arenediazonium) ion, joined by double-headed resonance arrows, so this is one set of drawn species and not a reaction. First: aromatic benzene ring carrying +N(triple bond)N with the plus on the ring-bound N and a lone pair on the terminal N. The other three are drawn as cyclohexadienyl cations with an exocyclic C=N+=N- : plus on the ring carbon ortho (2nd), para (3rd) and the other ortho (4th) to the diazonium carbon -- the 2nd and 4th are the two equivalent ortho forms drawn on opposite sides, so they come out as the same molecule written from different atoms, which is what the page draws. Curved electron-pushing arrows and lone-pair dots are annotations and carry no SMILES. No name is printed beside any structure, so all labels are empty.
